body:
# Independent audit of free source-facet affine neutrality

Source read in full: `candidate 00208e2b45f0da1a`, Sections 1–4.

Result: **PASS**. All conclusions retain the stated regularity, actual source freedom, canonical circuit, and single selected-cover hypotheses.

## Actual free perturbations

For each fixed target q, the representation set excluding q is a finite-dimensional compact polytope. Its extreme representations suffice because every support sum is linear in the coefficient vector. A representation using q with weight less than one reduces by division by1-a_q; weight one is trivial. Thus preservation of the finitely many extreme inclusions preserves every fiber exactly after taking the hull.

A compact Minkowski sum strictly inside a positive convex target has a uniform positive support margin over unit normals. Finiteness makes the common margin positive. Each affected inclusion changes only one side's support by at most the Hausdorff perturbation bound, since the target is excluded from its own source representation. The strict-freedom argument therefore permits all sufficiently small positive AND negative source perturbations.

Replacing n dot x<=h by n dot x<=h+t psi(x), for affine psi, is an actual perturbation of one normal and offset. The d-fold vertex systems remain nonsingular and the opposite-vertex inequalities remain strict. Bounded positive simplices persist for both signs. Differentiating at a fixed relative-interior point of the original facet gives normal speed psi because n is initially unit. Edge contributions have zero (d-1)-measure. Thus independent signed facet-affine velocities are genuinely realized, rather than arbitrary formal speed fields. The interval specialization is also valid.

## Moment rigidity

On facet F_i, cap j!=i is exactly q_j v_j+(1-q_j)F_i, with relative area(1-q_j)^(d-1) and centroid q_j v_j+(1-q_j)g_i. Cap i is empty because q_i>0. Constant tests force a_j=theta_j(1-q_j)^(d-1)=beta/d. First-moment tests then give sum_(j!=i)q_j(v_j-g_i)=0. Affine independence on F_i forces all remaining q_j equal. For d>=2 every pair of indices belongs to some such facet, hence all q_j=1/(d+1). Normalization yields uniform theta and beta=Gamma_d exactly. For d=1 only the constant endpoint conditions survive, giving beta1/2 without a false claim about y.

The weights use full proper coarea across ALL fibers. No equality of external statuses, volumes or shapes is assumed in the moment proof. Regularity is essential: supporting allocations would change the response weights and the trace and are correctly excluded.

## Minimum and cover application

A single selected circuit covering every deepest base plane gives an actual upper comparison for the perturbed global depth after its equal-budget shifts. Positive dependence preserves each assigned whole-plane cover. Persistent strict covers at the other finite bases supply the remaining upper comparison. If any signed source direction had negative normalized response, that would contradict the assumed actual local minimum. The response is linear under the regular hypotheses, so feasibility of both signs forces zero for each independent affine source-facet test. This proves precisely equation(2).

The source explicitly does not apply that argument separately to several witnesses, where the maximum of their different responses need not be linear. Its conclusion beta=Gamma_d excludes a below-Gamma_d/2^n minimum under the hypotheses; it does not assert the hypotheses at every minimum.

## Translation status condition

For a unit continuous normal, translating one fiber by t changes its cap volume at rate S_j(z)u_j dot t. Neutrality for all t gives a positive-kernel relation with coefficients theta_j S_j(z). A one-dimensional positive kernel and theta_j proportional to rho_j/S_j force S_j(z)/S_j constant in j. Since S_j>0, either every numerator is positive or all vanish. Lower-dimensional supporting traces have zero proper coarea; positive-area supporting coincidences are excluded as stated. No uncontrolled coordinate transformation or status simplification enters.

No correction requested.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
